verdict.rationale: Sentry publishes its own public API reference at docs.sentry.io/api/, with per-endpoint pages such as "Bulk Mutate a List of Issues" and a versioning section. It also maintains an official OpenAPI 3.0.3 spec in getsentry/sentry-api-schema. No evidence shows the reference is interactive or offers runnable examples, so only the explorable-reference part of the story is supported. Missing for 10: an interactive try-it console, runnable request examples, and hands-on or independent confirmation of interactivity.
